Sofia: quick sync - proposing a "soft-affinity token" for multi-region failover. goal: avoid accidental state in non-resident regions while keeping low-latency reads/writes during short flaps.

Ethan: short version of token?

Sofia: token = signed(region,epoch,consent_flags,expiry). proxies attach X-Soft-Affinity-Token when forwarding. dataplane verifies token before persisting; if missing/invalid return 409 with hint. tokens are short-lived (default 8s) and only allowed for idempotent or compensatable ops.

Maya: telemetry + ops asks: token-issue-rate, token-verify-fail, forward-rejects-by-tenant, and a per-tenant token-health dashboard. also global kill-switch to disable tokens.

Jules: security: tenants with PII default to token-disabled unless escrowed KMS + audit retention configured. token signing uses tenant-scoped keys.

Sofia: tests: control-plane partition (token push failure), token replay attempts, and chaos with mixed idempotent/non-idempotent traffic. reconciliation sweeper removes transient keys older than TTL + margin.

deploy-bot: created ticket ARCH-7017: soft-affinity-tokens + telemetry + canary.

Ethan: next steps: Sofia drafts RFC with header proto, tenant metadata flags, and SDK error mapping. I'll help with telemetry hooks. Maya will own ops dashboard.

Sofia: thanks, will post RFC later today. :sparkles:
